title: Sany unveils autonomous electric construction machinery
summary: At bauma China 2026 in Shanghai, Chinese construction machinery manufacturer Sany is presenting several electric machines specifically developed for autonomous operation. The new products include a battery-electric mining truck in the 100-ton class with 800-volt technology and an electric roller with over 1,000 kWh of battery capacity.

title: Bolt launches autonomous ride-hailing service in Luxembourg
summary: Bolt has officially launched its self-driving car service in Luxembourg. The vehicles operate in autonomous mode at SAE Level 4 and are equipped with Pony.ai's seventh-generation driving system. The fleet consists of the electric SUV Arcfox Alpha T5.

title: Arriva secures two-billion-euro contract for electric buses in North Holland
summary: Arriva has secured a long-term contract for bus services in the northwest of the Dutch province of North Holland. The agreement includes the deployment of over 200 electric buses as well as adjustments to the route network. With this, Arriva continues its growth trajectory in the Netherlands following several major contracts.

title: India: Ultraviolette Automotive breaks ground on new e-2W plant
summary: Indian electric two-wheeler manufacturer Ultraviolette Automotive on Thursday broke ground on its second vehicle plant, located in Hosur, an industrial city in the southern state of Tamil Nadu. The new facility will expand the company's annual production capacity to around 300,000 units.

title: Monta connects nearly 4,500 charging ports to North American roaming platform
summary: Danish charging software provider Monta has agreed to connect its charge point management system to ChargeHub's Passport Hub roaming platform. The move could potentially bring up to 4,500 additional charging points into the ChargeHub ecosystem.

title: 250 new EZO charging locations planned in Scotland
summary: EZO is set to develop over 250 new public EV charging locations across northern Scotland by 2030, as part of an expansion programme covering Aberdeen City, Aberdeenshire, Highland and Moray. The first new site at Aviemore Community and Leisure Centre is now operational, featuring one 50 kW DC charger and two 11 kW AC charging points.

title: GRIDSERVE secures £420m to refinance debt and expand charging network
summary: UK charging network operator GRIDSERVE has secured £420 million in new financing. This will provide funding for the further expansion of its public charging infrastructure, including ultra-rapid facilities away from motorway services areas.

title: Jula Logistics orders 20 more battery-electric trucks from Scania
summary: Swedish logistics company Jula Logistics and transport service provider EcoLink are expanding their electric truck fleet. Following an initial batch of 20 electric trucks from Scania, they have now ordered an additional 20 vehicles. With a battery capacity of 802 kWh, the new e-trucks are also set to be used in long-haul transport across Sweden.

title: CATL introduces 100kWh ’30#’ swappable battery for passenger cars
summary: CATL has introduced a new battery pack for its battery-swapping ecosystem in China. The "30#" battery block offers a capacity of 100 kWh and can be swapped in under a minute. Alternatively, the swappable battery can also be fast-charged at a conventional charging station.

title: Mahle combines autonomous parking with inductive charging
summary: Automotive supplier Mahle has developed a system that combines autonomous parking with wireless charging. The so-called Park & Charge Pilot enables inductive charging with up to 11 kW. Together with the BMW Group, Mahle is currently testing the underlying charging technology in a BMW iX3.

title: Porsche Boxster goes electric: our test drive of the prototype
summary: In our first test drive, the electric Porsche Boxster demonstrated how it aims to win the hearts of petrolheads as the brand's first E-Roadster. With over 500 hp, a sprint in under three seconds, and a battery replacing the mid-engine, it navigates through the city, countryside, and mountain passes. Added to this are sound and shifting scenarios - and a price that is set to be significantly lower than that of the 911.

title: Energica plans to restart production in India
summary: Italian electric motorcycle manufacturer Energica plans a fresh start following its insolvency in 2024. Under new Singaporean ownership, production will be relocated to India, reducing the sales prices of its e-motorcycles by approximately 20 percent.

title: Audi E7X Becomes First Model of China Sub-Brand with Range Extender
summary: The Chinese Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) has listed a new version of the AUDI E7X. This is the first model with a range extender from Audi's Chinese sub-brand. It is produced by SAIC Volkswagen.

title: Hyundai unveils compact Ioniq SUV for China – with swappable batteries
summary: Hyundai is presenting another study from its Ioniq series, tailored specifically for the Chinese market, at the Auto Guangzhou trade show. The Mercury Concept is an intelligent B-segment SUV that is set to go on sale as a production model as early as 2027. In one version, it will also feature swappable batteries.

title: More Stellantis plants face production halt in France
summary: Stellantis is once again temporarily halting production for several weeks at its Sochaux, Rennes, and Mulhouse plants in France - citing the "challenging European market, aggressive competition, and a complicated geopolitical situation".

title: Changan Subsidiary Avatr Expands into Switzerland
summary: Avatr enters the Swiss market in 2027 with the 07L and 06T models. Kamps Import AG will handle distribution alongside Schmohl AG, with prices starting around 59,900 CHF (approx. €65,500) and deliveries scheduled for spring 2027.

title: IONNA opens 22-bay charging hub in California and adds Tesla Autocharge
summary: US charging network IONNA has opened a new flagship site in Westminster, California, featuring 22 charging bays with peak power of up to 400 kW. The opening coincides with the expansion of automatic charging authentication to Tesla vehicles, with support for models from Stellantis brands set to follow in December.

title: Volvo marks 50th anniversary of its first electric car
summary: The automotive future arrived in 1976 in butter yellow, drove a maximum of 70 km/h, and needed a ten-hour break after 50 kilometres. Half a century ago, Volvo introduced its first electric car: the Elbil.

title: Subaru E-Outback to launch in UK from £49,995
summary: Subaru has confirmed UK pricing for its new all-electric flagship, the E-Outback, with the electric SUV starting at £49,995. The Japanese manufacturer is offering four trim levels, with initial customer deliveries scheduled for early 2027.

title: Mercedes-Benz GLA test drive: compact SUV with 800-volt architecture and two-tonne towing capacity
summary: The new Mercedes-Benz GLA 350 4MATIC electric sets technical benchmarks in the crowded compact electric SUV segment. With its 800-volt architecture, 85-kWh battery, and two-speed transmission, the all-wheel-drive model combines high efficiency with short charging stops. A large frunk, a two-ton towing capacity, and the new MB.OS operating system also enhance its everyday practicality.

title: Allego secures financing package of up to €720 million euros
summary: Dutch charging infrastructure operator Allego announces it has secured financing of nearly three-quarters of a billion euros. The company continues to face high capital requirements - especially in light of its UK expansion plans.

title: Nissan recognises Aviloo’s battery tests
summary: Nissan Automotive Europe has recognised Austrian battery diagnostics specialist Aviloo as an independent provider for assessing the battery condition of used EVs. The company's battery certificates can thus be used as part of Nissan's Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) used car program.

title: Stagecoach brings 21 electric buses into service in North Devon
summary: Stagecoach South West has introduced 21 battery-electric buses to the southwestern UK county, thus marking the first phase of its electric bus rollout across the county. The new vehicles have entered service from the operator's Barnstaple depot, following earlier deployments in Exeter and Torbay.

title: Kim Long Motor delivers 100 electric sleeper buses in Vietnam
summary: Vietnamese electric commercial vehicle manufacturer Kim Long Motor has handed over a fleet of 100 electric sleeper buses to Futa Bus Lines, a major homegrown bus operator based in Ho Chi Minh City. The latter has put them into service on intercity routes.

title: UK energy price cap increase could add up to £9 to EV charging costs
summary: Charging an electric car at home could become noticeably more expensive in the UK from January, as a sharp rise in energy prices threatens to erode some of the cost advantages of running an EV. The impact will depend heavily on the driver's energy supplier and tariff, with households on standard variable deals facing the biggest immediate challenge.

title: EU postpones discussion on Tesla Assisted Driving
summary: EU-wide approval of Tesla's driver assistance system, Tesla Assisted Driving (TAD), is set to face further delays. A meeting of the relevant EU expert committee which was first scheduled for December 1 has now been postponed to December 15.

title: KAIST aims to extend the lifespan of anode-free batteries
summary: Researchers at the South Korean Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) have developed an approach to extend the lifespan of anode-free lithium-metal batteries. They are leveraging a manufacturing process from the semiconductor industry and a coating just ten nanometers thick.

title: Volvo A40 Electric begins first construction site deployment
summary: Four electric articulated haulers of the Volvo A40 Electric type have begun their first construction site deployment at the British infrastructure project Lower Thames Crossing. The vehicles can each transport up to 39 tonnes of construction material. The charging electricity is generated on-site from green hydrogen.

title: BMW to roll out a new software update in December
summary: BMW provides over-the-air updates to 16 million vehicles in 88 countries and is set to roll out version 11/2026.3 of its software in December. The update introduces 24 new and revised features for assistance, navigation, charging, infotainment, and comfort.

title: Xiaomi prepares for EU market launch with test drives across Europe
summary: Xiaomi is pushing ahead with its plans to enter the European market in 2027 and has named Sweden, Germany, Spain, and Italy as test countries. Testing and coordination for the European market will take place at a total of seven locations, including Arjeplog in Sweden and the Nürburgring in Germany. Meanwhile, the operating loss of the vehicle, AI, and other new initiatives division increased further in the third quarter of 2026.
